call_id.notes: Unique call identifier; high-cardinality; typically excluded from modeling.

customer_id.notes: Unique customer identifier; high-cardinality; often excluded to avoid leakage.

call_date.notes: Raw date string; useful only if engineered into day/month/week features.

call_time.notes: Raw time string; useful only if converted into hour-of-day or time bucket.

agent_id.notes: Identifier for the agent; categorical feature; moderate cardinality.

agent_name.notes: Human-readable agent name; redundant with agent_id; usually dropped.

primary_scenario.notes: High-level scenario category (billing, outage, cancellation, etc.). Strong categorical signal.

call_transcript.notes: Raw transcript text; not used directly in tabular models; used to generate NLP features.

call_successful.notes: Binary success flag; may cause target leakage depending on prediction task.

customer_service_count.notes: Number of customer service interactions in the last 12 months.

customer_issue_history.notes: Count of past issues or complaints; numeric predictor.
